answer.reason: The verses show the Holy Place being furnished and cleansed with atonement, which goes beyond its summary position.

clauses.english: received the table, the candlestick and the golden altar
clauses.quote: he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail

clauses.english: had atonement made for it because of Israel's uncleanness
clauses.quote: he shall make an atonement for the holy place

doubts: EXO 40:22-26 say 'tent of the congregation' without using the words 'holy place'; they are taken as the furnishing of the Holy Place because the verses are marked.
The many verses on priests ministering or eating in the holy place were left out as instructions, not events.
